stage1.impression: A hi-fi dealer's demo room more than a night listening bar. The fir-lined niche is the brightest and best thing in the frame, and the two clear-smoke speakers sit darker than the wall behind them. The near tub chair is a black mass, the floor is a flat dead plane, and there is no concrete, beam or steel in view. The blurred guest on the right reads as a smooth CG mannequin whose legs hover in front of the chair. A design magazine would not publish this as a specific place: it reads as a generic audio showroom, with nothing of Planet EARF's shell, counter or acrylic lamps to identify it.

blocking_9: The speakers must be the hero: each speaker region's lum_median at 45 or more, and brighter than the fir behind it
The shell (board-formed concrete, a Douglas fir beam or blackened steel) must be visible somewhere in the frame, so the room reads as Planet EARF and not as a dealer demo room
The guest must read as a real person sitting in a chair: a body with weight, no smooth mannequin limbs, nothing floating
The foreground must hold detail: no near chair as a crushed black block, and pools of light from the Orbs on the oak tables
The floor must carry some light (reflections or falloff from the altar spots), not be a uniform flat grey-brown plane
No visible render grain at 1:1 in the mid-tones (wall panels and the right-hand screen)

defects.what: Left speaker underexposed for the hero: lum_median 35.3 (target 45 or more); the fir around it at about 74 out-reads it
The niche soffit and the top of the fir carry hotspots (p95 237.6) brighter than anything on the speakers; the eye goes to the wall, not the product
The blurred guest is a smooth untextured mannequin; legs extend horizontally and hover in front of the chair with no contact; the head is an orange blob
The near tub chair is crushed: lum_median 1.4, crush_pct 57.5; a black slab across the lower-left third
The floor is flat and uniform (lum_range 35.6, p95 40.2), with no reflection, texture or pool of light from the altar
A large flat grey screen on the right wall with a single white square: reads as an empty display, a dead mid-grey slab
The shell above and right is a featureless near-black (median 12.3); no concrete board marks, beams or steel to be seen
The dark absorber panels behind both speakers are flat, untextured rectangles with CG-clean edges
The Orb lamp on the left is clipped at the edge of frame and its table pool is small; the lamp reads as a white blob
Visible fine render grain on the fir and the panels at 1:1

changes.problem: The speakers are darker than the fir behind them, so the hero does not read at a glance.

evidence.measured: left speaker lum_median 35.3; right speaker [640,265,760,485] 55.3; fir niche [100,70,880,560] 73.8

change.to: 34.0 W, cone 14.0 deg, aimed at each cabinet's mid-height so the cone lands on the speaker and the plinth, not the fir

changes.expected: Both speakers lift to median about 50 to 60; their acrylic edges and the batts read; the fir falls into a halo around them.

changes.problem: The niche's lit strip and soffit downlights blow hotspots on the fir that outshine the speakers.
changes.expected: The fir stays warm but steps back; soffit p95 drops under about 210 and the fir median about 55 to 65.

changes.problem: The frame shows only the niche, carpet and a black chair, with none of the concrete, fir beams or steel, so it reads as a generic demo room.

evidence.measured: upper right is featureless, median 12.3; no shell material identifiable anywhere

change.to: position [11.4, 4.6, 1.10] (a seated eye height, further back and nearer the centre line), target [16.4, 3.0, 1.15], 32 mm, so the near tub chair goes out of the lower-left corner and a concrete side wall and a ceiling beam enter at the top and the left edge

changes.expected: The altar stays central and the shell frames it; there is no black chair slab, and the room reads as a specific place.

changes.problem: The blurred guest reads as a CG mannequin with legs floating in front of the chair.

evidence.measured: smooth untextured limbs, horizontal legs not touching the floor or the chair; a featureless orange head blob

change.from: 1 in a tub chair at the right edge, head travel [0.16, 0.09, 0.03] m, turn 30 deg
change.to: 1 seated deep in a mid-ground tub chair facing the altar, seen from behind and three-quarter (hips on the cushion, feet on the floor, a glass on the table), head travel [0.06, 0.04, 0.01] m, turn 12 deg; the body itself still

changes.expected: A believable listener in silhouette against the lit niche, with a soft head blur only; no mannequin limbs at frame edge.

changes.problem: The foreground has no pools of light; the Orbs on the oak tables are too weak to model the velvet chairs.
changes.expected: Warm pools on each oak table and a readable velvet rim on the nearest chairs; crush in the lower-left band drops below 35 %.

changes.problem: The floor is a flat uniform plane with no response to the altar light.

evidence.measured: lum_range 35.6, p95 40.2, no reflection or falloff

change.to: a satin sealed finish (roughness about 0.35) so the plinths and the altar spots throw a soft, broken reflection toward the camera

changes.expected: A soft streak of warm reflection under each plinth and natural falloff toward the camera; floor p95 rises to about 60 or more.

changes.problem: The air is too clean for a night bar; the spot cones and the pools have no atmosphere, and the dark shell is empty.

evidence.measured: median 12.3, lum_range 28.9: flat dark with no gradient

changes.expected: The altar and Dome cones become faintly visible; the dark areas gain a gentle gradient without lifting the blacks into grey.

changes.problem: Fine render grain is visible in the mid-tones at 1:1, and the right-hand screen reads as a dead grey slab.

evidence.measured: median 36.6 flat grey screen; grain visible on the fir and the panels in crops

change.setting: render samples and the screens' brightness
change.to: samples 512 (adaptive 0.01), screens 0.0015 so the screen sinks into the shadow instead of reading as a grey panel

changes.expected: A cleaner mid-tone texture; the screen recedes to a dark surface with a faint image.

out_of_scope.request: Give the Smoke speakers more visible tint, so the frame has a colour from the product
out_of_scope.why: Their colour is fixed by the configuration; in Smoke the frame's single colour is necessarily faint, so the hero must be carried by light, not by tint

out_of_scope.request: Replace the flat dark absorber panels behind the speakers with something that has texture or depth
out_of_scope.why: They are part of the altar as designed; only their finish might change, and that belongs to the room's designer

out_of_scope.request: Show the counter, record wall or Dome pendants in this hero to make the place specific
out_of_scope.why: The frame is defined as the listening room; adding them is a change of shot, not a fix
